# ChatGPT on Telegram. ## Unlock the power of ChatGPT anywhere on Telegram. Enhance any conversation with the power of ChatGPT on Telegram. Summon it anywhere, anytime, to answer all your questions without ever leaving Telegram. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for ChatGPT on Telegram. I am a big fan of Telegram and while chatting with friends, family or in group conversations I often find myself wanting to use ChatGPT to give a smart reply. For now it's quite painful to do so: 1. Wait for the answer 6. Paste it in the right conversation on Telegram Actually most of the times it doesn't work or I get lazy to wait or login, especially from the phone. That is why I decided to create this bot and to make ChatGPT accessible from any Telegram conversation. You can summon it by using the Telegram Inline mode, by adding the bot to a group or by just talking directly to it. I let you try it. I cannot make the bot remember the conversation. Shouldn't this be a feature, to be able to control the start and the stop of a conversation? I can paste it into ChatGPT regular UI and it answers it. You will be able to use the "reply" feature of telegram to answer specific message and therefore use the history. 2. There is a limit currently of 500 characters that I set to avoid spikes in the API cost and therefore to be able to keep the price low for the premium users. I've wanted to use ChatGPT within Telegram for a long time! I tried talking with it and it responsed to my first message. Please try again” By the way, the “Please wait while I think...” message is super annoying and clutters the conversation.
